title-group.article-title: Effects of X on Y: A Systematic Review

abstract.p: We reviewed the literature on the effect of X on Y.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We searched PubMed and Embase through December 2022.
Inclusion criteria were cohort studies with at least 50 participants.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Fourteen studies met criteria, involving 3,120 patients.
The pooled estimate was 0.42 (95% CI 0.31 to 0.55).
